mapper.select: SELECT A.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD AS oprcElmtClsCd, A.SORT_SEQ AS sortSeq, A.OP_NM_DGNS_NM AS opNmDgnsNm, A.ANST_KND_NM AS anstKndNm, OP_DTM::DATE AS opDtm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.TH1_PFDR_STF_NO) AS th1PfdrStfNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.TH2_PFDR_STF_NO) AS th2PfdrStfNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.TH3_PFDR_STF_NO) AS th3PfdrStfNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.TH1_ATDR_STF_NO) AS th1AtdrStfNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.TH2_ATDR_STF_NO) AS th2AtdrStfNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.TH3_ATDR_STF_NO) AS th3AtdrStfNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.TH4_ATDR_STF_NO) AS th4AtdrStfNm FROM ODS.S_MRDDRONE A WHERE A.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} ORDER BY OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD
